title: Why Physics Ends the Free Will Debate
speaker: Michio Kaku
description: Michio Kaku argues that quantum mechanics undermines the concept of free will — and what that means for how we think about consciousness, choice, and human identity.

title: Don't Advertise to Aliens — The Fermi Paradox
speaker: Michio Kaku
description: Kaku explains the Fermi Paradox — if aliens exist, why haven't we heard from them? — and why broadcasting our location into space might be a dangerous idea.

title: The Unconscious Makes the Best Decisions
speaker: Eric Kandel
description: Nobel laureate Eric Kandel explains how the unconscious brain processes information and makes decisions before our conscious mind is even aware — with surprising implications for creativity.

title: Free Will: Is It an Illusion?
speaker: Steven Pinker
description: Cognitive scientist Steven Pinker tackles the age-old question of free will — exploring what neuroscience says about conscious choice and why the debate matters for morality and law.

title: The Psychology of Happiness
speaker: Sheila Heen
description: Harvard negotiation expert Sheila Heen explores what psychological research reveals about happiness — why we're bad at predicting what will make us happy, and what actually does.

title: The Evolution of Human Intelligence
speaker: Michio Kaku
description: Michio Kaku traces the evolution of the human brain — from primates to modern Homo sapiens — and asks whether artificial intelligence could surpass us on the same evolutionary scale.

title: How I Reversed My Unhappiness
speaker: Tal Ben-Shahar
description: Positive psychology pioneer Tal Ben-Shahar shares the personal crisis that led him to study happiness — and the counterintuitive lessons about meaning, acceptance, and what makes life worthwhile.

title: Why the Teenage Brain Craves Risk
speaker: Robert Sapolsky
description: Robert Sapolsky explains the neuroscience behind teenage risk-taking — why adolescent brains are wired differently, how the prefrontal cortex develops, and what this means for how we treat young people.

title: The Neuroscience of Creativity
speaker: Beau Lotto
description: Neuroscientist Beau Lotto reveals how the brain generates creative ideas — why uncertainty is essential for innovation, and how changing your perceptions can unlock new ways of thinking.

title: Developing a Growth Mindset
speaker: Carol Dweck
description: Stanford psychologist Carol Dweck explains the difference between a fixed mindset and a growth mindset — and how believing your abilities can develop changes what you achieve.
